content_zh:
“如果，如果……我再昏迷一次的话。我的身体素质，恐怕就能达到武者的要求了。”
当然，自己要的‘昏迷’，不是被人打得昏迷过去。而是头疼到极限，而昏迷过去。
罗峰有头疼的病症。
每天都会偶尔有一阵头疼，不过每次忍忍就过去了，而头疼到极限，就会昏迷！
从小到大，罗峰一共昏迷过两次。
八岁那年，弟弟被车压断了腿，那次罗峰伤心过度，突然觉得自己头非常的疼，同时心跳也快速的惊人，全身血液流转速度达到一个惊人的地步，感觉到自己心脏好像要从胸腔跳出来一样，直至承受不了直接昏迷。
还有十二岁那年，妈妈重病入院，害怕失去妈妈的罗峰，惊慌的很，同样头疼的要命，心跳速度惊人，再一次昏迷。
两次昏迷，家里人曾经带罗峰去医院检查，可根本查不出毛病。毕竟就算是现在，脑部依旧是医学上难以攻克的难题。
“不过，两次昏迷却诡异地让我身体素质都提高了一大截。”罗峰期待的很，“八岁，十二岁，这两次昏迷醒来后，我的力量、速度、神经反应明显强了很多。这才让我十六周岁刚进入武馆，就直接通过中级学员考核，获得‘中级学员’称号。正因为基础好，我十七周岁又获得‘高级学员’称号。”
“如果，我能再昏迷一次，实力肯定能再度跃升一次！”
昏迷，其实是身体的自我保护，并非完全是坏事。
罗峰从小就有头疼病，不过八岁那年第一次昏迷后，他就发现，每次头疼减轻了不少。等到十二岁那年，又一次昏迷之后。每次头疼又再度减轻。
“按照这样的趋势，我如果能再昏迷一次。头疼情况应该会再度减轻……昏迷个一两次，或许，头疼病就永远消失了。”罗峰心中渴望的很，毕竟昏迷一次，自己头疼病证就减轻。而且身体素质还会有一个跃迁。
可惜……
昏迷不是说，想昏迷就昏迷的。从小到大，也不过发生两次而已。
“头疼到极限，心跳速度也会快到极限。”
罗峰低头看了看手腕上的手表，这是一块含有‘测试脉搏’功能的手表。
“可是，就算极限奔跑，一分钟心跳也不超过120次。”罗峰看着手表，“如果我一分钟心跳，能达到两百多次，那多好。”昏迷前的征兆就是头非常疼、心跳非常快。
可惜——
不管运动如何剧烈，自己的心跳速度，也无法快到能头疼昏迷的地步。

※※※※※※
练武厅内，脸上有着刀疤的杨武，站在拳力测试机前。也没有认真蓄势，很随意的就是左右双拳猛烈的击打向拳靶，蓬！蓬！蓬！一连窜低沉的拳击声响起，拳力测试机的屏幕上流过一连窜的数字——“956kg，912kg，936kg，981kg……”
杨武一口气击打了数十拳这才停了下来。
旁边观看的罗峰，不由一阵羡慕，自己全力一拳也就809公斤。如果向杨哥这样连续迅速出拳，每一拳的力道能超过七百公斤就算不错了。
“杨哥，哪天我全力一拳，能有你这么随意一拳的力道。那就好了。”罗峰在一旁笑道。
“你小子。”杨武走过来，笑着一拍罗峰肩膀，“你今年才19岁，也就18周岁而已。你杨哥我像你这么大的时候，还只是武馆的中级学员呢。以你的进步速度……不要多，两年，绝对能达到武者的身体素质要求。啧啧……20周岁的武者，真是让人嫉妒啊。”
罗峰一笑。
武馆招收学员，是16周岁到30周岁，是因为这一个阶段成长最迅速。越早能跨入武者行列，代表以后实力会更强大。自己去年17周岁，就成为武馆高级学员。的确是让很多人羡慕。
“对了，疯子，你要高考了吧？准备高考后干什么？”杨武笑道。
“我准备考军校。”罗峰微微一笑，“一般军校收的学生，毕业后只是当普通军队的基层军官。而我，毕业后进入一些特种军队，应该不成问题。”
“哦。”

content_en:
"If, if...I fall into a coma again, my physical fitness will probably meet the requirements of a warrior."
Of course, the 'coma' I want is not to be beaten unconscious. Instead, he had a severe headache and passed out.
Luo Feng has a headache.
Occasionally I have a headache every day, but every time I endure it, it passes. When the headache reaches the extreme, I will fall into coma!
Since childhood, Luo Feng has been in coma twice.
When he was eight years old, his younger brother was crushed by a car and broke his leg. Luo Feng was overly sad that time and suddenly felt a severe pain in his head. At the same time, his heartbeat was extremely fast. The blood flow in his body reached an alarming rate. He felt as if his heart was about to jump out of his chest, until he couldn't bear it and fell into coma.
When he was twelve years old, his mother was seriously ill and was hospitalized. Luo Feng, who was afraid of losing his mother, was very panicked. He also had a terrible headache, his heartbeat was beating at an alarming rate, and he fell into coma again.
After falling into coma twice, his family took Luo Feng to the hospital for examination, but nothing could be found wrong. After all, even now, the brain is still an insurmountable problem in medicine.
"However, the two comas have strangely improved my physical fitness a lot." Luo Feng looked forward to it. "After waking up from these two comas at the age of eight and twelve, my strength, speed, and neurological reactions were significantly stronger. This is why I directly passed the intermediate student assessment when I entered the martial arts gym at the age of sixteen and was awarded the title of 'intermediate student'. Because of my good foundation, I was awarded the title of 'advanced student' when I was seventeen."
"If I can be unconscious again, my strength will definitely rise again!"
Coma is actually the body's self-protection and is not entirely a bad thing.
Luo Feng had suffered from headaches since he was a child, but after he fell into coma for the first time at the age of eight, he found that his headaches were relieved a lot each time. When I was twelve years old, I fell into coma again. Each time the headaches subsided again.
"According to this trend, if I can coma again, my headaches should be alleviated again... If I coma once or twice, maybe the headaches will disappear forever." Luo Feng was eager in his heart. After all, his headaches would be relieved once he was in coma. And there will be a leap in physical fitness.
What a pity...
Being in a coma does not mean that you can become comatose if you want to. It only happened twice since childhood.
"My headache is extremely severe and my heart rate is extremely fast."
Luo Feng lowered his head and looked at the watch on his wrist. This was a watch with a 'pulse test' function.
"But even if I run to the extreme, my heartbeat does not exceed 120 times a minute." Luo Feng looked at his watch. "It would be great if my heartbeat could reach more than 200 times a minute." The signs before coma are a very painful head and a very fast heartbeat.
It's a pity——
No matter how strenuous the exercise was, his heart rate could not be fast enough to cause him to suffer from a headache and pass out.

In the martial arts training hall, Yang Wu, who had a scar on his face, stood in front of the boxing strength testing machine. He didn't prepare his momentum seriously, he just hit the target with his left and right fists casually, Peng! Peng! Peng! A series of low boxing sounds sounded, and a series of numbers flowed on the screen of the boxing strength testing machine - "956kg, 912kg, 936kg, 981kg..."
Yang Wu punched dozens of times before stopping.
Luo Feng, who was watching from the side, couldn't help but feel envious. One punch with his full strength only weighed 809 kilograms. If Xiang Ge Yang punches quickly and continuously like this, it would be good if the force of each punch exceeds 700 kilograms.
"Brother Yang, one day if I punch with all my strength, it will be as powerful as your casual punch. That would be great." Luo Feng said with a smile.
"You kid." Yang Wu came over, smiled and patted Luo Feng on the shoulder, "You are only 19 years old this year, which means you are only 18 years old. When you, Brother Yang, and I were your age, I was only an intermediate student in the martial arts school. At your rate of progress... noIt takes more than two years to definitely meet the physical fitness requirements of a warrior. Tsk tsk... A 20-year-old warrior is really enviable. "
Luo Feng smiled.
Martial arts schools recruit students between the ages of 16 and 30 because they grow the fastest at this stage. The sooner you can step into the ranks of warriors, the more powerful you will be in the future. When he turned 17 last year, he became a senior student in the martial arts school. It is indeed the envy of many people.
"By the way, madman, are you going to take the college entrance examination? What to do after preparing for the college entrance examination? "Yang Wu said with a smile.
“I’m preparing to take the military academy entrance examination. Luo Feng smiled slightly, "Generally, students accepted by military academies only serve as junior officers in the ordinary army after graduation." As for me, it shouldn't be a problem to join some special forces after graduation. "
